business.body: Beta Drugs is part of the Adley Group, founded by Vijay Batra. It develops, manufactures and markets oncology formulations, mainly cytotoxic drugs, as tablets, capsules, oral suspensions and injectables, including lyophilised injectables. It has four main businesses: CDMO (contract manufacturing for other Indian pharma companies), its own brands sold in India to hospitals and through distributors, exports, and APIs made at its subsidiary Adley Labs. About 80% of the API used in its formulations is made in-house. It has added a dermatology and cosmetology division with in-licensed Italian dermal fillers. It has also acquired Nivan Lifesciences, which sells IVF and fertility products, and an oncology intermediates facility next to its API plant. It exports mainly to Southeast Asia, CIS countries, Latin America and Africa.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Oncology own brands:** Beedan (dasatinib), Adsunib (sunitinib), Adleap (enzalutamide), GEM-RTU, Caxfila OS, Methotrexate oral solution, Adcumin, Addcure
- **API:** Oncology/cytotoxic APIs (Adley Labs), Oncology intermediates
- **CDMO:** Oncology formulations for third-party brands
- **Derma / cosmetology:** Dermal fillers (Promo Italia), Meso-fills, Frezyderm products
- **Fertility:** IVF products (Nivan Lifesciences)

themes.title: Pharma CDMO / CRDMO & API import-substitution
themes.need: Global biopharma's China+1 sourcing plus a peptide/biologics modality boom drive India's CDMO/CRDMO build-out and API import-substitution. ANTHEM/COHANCE/NEULANDLAB/SYNGENE-tier on CRDMO (peptides/ADCs/oligos); DIVISLAB/LAURUSLABS on peptide CDMO; AKUMS/INNOVACAP/RUBICON on formulation CDMO; AARTIPHARM/SUPRIYA/AARTIDRUGS/SOLARA on APIs; SIGACHI/NATCAPSUQ/VIDHIING on excipients.
themes.driver: Customer regulatory filings unlocking dedicated capacity; new CRDMO molecule wins; API price/volume recovery.
